releases.name: 100milionseek 0.1.3
releases.body:
Inline logo and a fixed Chinese summary.

- `magpie.icon` is now an inline SVG data URI, so the plugin card shows the logo without depending on the site's favicon staying reachable.
- The zh summary is proper Chinese again (it was mojibake from an earlier encoding slip).

Install: `magpie plugin add 100milionseek`
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/100milionseek

releases.name: 100milionseek 0.1.2
releases.body:
Fix: sign-in now receives the API key.

Without a prompt, magpie drew its own key box and called authorize() with no key, so sign-in failed with "An API key is required". The method now declares a password prompt keyed `key`, which magpie hands to authorize() as inputs.key.

Install:  `magpie plugin add 100milionseek`
npm:      https://www.npmjs.com/package/100milionseek
